product_family: AI-powered B2B sales platform with outbound prospecting, inbound lead capture, data enrichment, and deal execution automation. Serves 600K+ companies.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type 2 Report (Security, Availability, Confidentiality) validated by independent auditors. Certified by A-LIGN, a leading third-party cybersecurity firm.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001 Recertification reflects our commitment to protecting your data through comprehensive security practices. Certified by A-LIGN.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR Compliant. Apollo operates as both Data Processor and Data Controller with comprehensive DPA and compliance obligations.

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: CCPA Compliant as listed on Trust Center. Users can submit opt-out requests and data access requests via Privacy Center.

certifications.name: CPRA
certifications.proof_quote: CPRA Compliant as listed on Trust Center. California residents have additional privacy rights supported.

certifications.name: EU-US Data Privacy Framework
certifications.proof_quote: EU-US DPF Certified as listed on Trust Center. Apollo relies on Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses for lawful cross-border data transfers to the United States.

certifications.name: CASA Tier 2
certifications.proof_quote: CASA Tier 2 audit completed. Cloud Application Security Assessment validates stringent security, privacy, and risk management controls.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence found on Apollo's trust center, security pages, or privacy documentation. Not advertised as a compliance capability.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Mentioned on homepage marketing materials but absent from official Trust Center and Security pages. No independent verification of PCI DSS certification found.

privacy.ai_training_note: Apollo explicitly trains AI models on customer data and Service Information. Privacy policy states: 'Apollo may use Service Information and business contact data as inputs to both internally developed models and third-party AI providers.' Users have the right to opt-out of such processing. Additionally, Apollo grants itself 'an irrevocable, perpetual, worldwide, transferable, sublicensable, and royalty-free license to analyze Customer Data using artificial intelligence to improve the Platform.'
privacy.data_region: United States (service and website hosted in US; exact data center locations not disclosed)

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: AES encryption over public networks using TLS/SSL protocols

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES encryption for idle data in databases with multi-layer protection

security.name: Database security
security.value: Multi-layer protection including encrypted passwords, two-factor authentication, intrusion detection systems, and VPC with strict firewall settings

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual network and graybox application penetration tests by certified third-party consultants

security.name: Audit frequency
security.value: Quarterly audits covering access control, risk, information security, IT infrastructure, and HR procedures

security.name: Incident notification
security.value: Customers notified of security incidents without undue delay, within 72 hours per GDPR requirements

security.name: Data recovery
security.value: Regular backups with maximum 24-hour RTO and RPO (Recovery Time/Point Objectives)

security.name: Integration security
security.value: OAuth2 used for SaaS integrations; credentials are not retained by Apollo

security.name: Subprocessor management
security.value: Apollo publishes authorized subprocessors at trust.apollo.io, provides 30-day notice before adding new subprocessors, and grants customers termination rights if they reasonably object

products.name: Apollo Sales Platform

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based with free tier and paid plans; enterprise available upon request
compare.data_residency: United States (configurable per Data Privacy Framework agreements)

flags: PCI DSS: Listed on homepage marketing materials but NOT on official Trust Center or Security documentation—potential over-claim on marketing homepage. Apollo does not process payment card data, suggesting PCI DSS may not be relevant or properly verified.

AI Training: Apollo trains models on customer data using 'irrevocable, perpetual, worldwide, transferable, sublicensable, and royalty-free license' language. Opt-out available but default behavior is to train. This is a significant data practice that should be clearly disclosed to users.
Data Sharing: Customer data is added to Apollo's Contributor Database and shared with other Apollo customers for data enrichment purposes. Users' own contacts may appear in other companies' searches.
Non-compete clause: Terms prohibit using Apollo's services to train competing products, which is a standard but restrictive clause.
Non-refundable: All subscriptions are non-cancelable during term and non-refundable per Terms of Service.
